main_text.p: קָשֶׁה Durum, Difficile esse. הִקְשָׁה Difficile reddere: Objicere, Opponere difficile & dubium. מַקְשָׁן Opponens, quaerens, interrogans quaestionem dubiam. קוּשְׁיָא Objectio, quaestio difficilis. קָשֶׁה Grave, difficile. קָשְׁיוּת Difficultas: בִּקּוּשִׁי Cum difficultate, Difficulter, Hof.ii.7. in R.Sal.
קשט Ornare: הִתְקַשֵּׁט Ornari, Ornare se. קשׁוּט Ornatus, Ornamentum.

קשׁר Ligare: Ligari, Ligatum esse, Referre, Construi, Constructum esse, apud Grammaticos, Psal.22.8. in Ab. Esra. קֶשֶׁר Ligatura, Vinculum, Praepositio, Nomen & Verbum ligans. פּוֹעֲלֵי קֶשֶׁר Verba vinculi, id est, cum Praepositione, cum alia voce constructa & ligata.

הִקִּישׁ קשש Assimilare, Comparare proportionaliter. הַקִּשָּׁה הַקִּישׁ Proportio, Syllogismus: Comparatio analoga. הֵקֵשׁ מִטְעֶה Syllogismus sophisticus, erroneus, errare faciens. קִשְׁקֵשׁ Pulsare campanam, Sonum, Tinnitum edere. קִשְׁקוּשִׁים Campana, Sonitus campanae. קִישׁ Sonus, Tinnitus, Strepitus, pulsus, proprie campanae vel tintinabuli: Unde illud, אִסְתְּרָא בְּלַגִּינָא קִישׁ קְרִיא Stater in lagena Ku Kis clamat, id est, numus commotus in lagena vacua, magnum edit strepitum. Proverbium in gloriosos & jactabundos.
קֶשֶׁת Arcus, Iris: קֶשֶׁת Sagittarius, Jaculator: Arcitenens, signum coelestæ.
רָאָה Videre. רָאוּי Dignum, Conveniens: יוֹתֵר מִן הָרָאוּי Magis quam convenit. כְּפִי הַנִּרְאֶה Sicut videtur, juxta apparentiam. רְאִיָּה Visio. רְאִיָּה Ratio, Probatio, Demon-stratio:

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and several Hebrew words are read from a small, slightly blurred scan and may be wrong; the running head letters are doubtful. The Hebrew line "אסתרא בלגינא קיש קריא" and the vowel marks in the entries are not certain. "Hof.ii.7." is printed in lowercase numerals. The line "stratio:" is the continuation of "Demon-" and is kept in the text.
